meta.name: technical-seo-checker
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "check technical SEO"; audits crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, and migrations. Not for on-page tags or content — use on-page-seo-auditor. 技术SEO/网站速度

copy.tagline: 检查网站技术SEO问题，提升搜索排名
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责网站SEO优化，需要排查技术问题
copy.tagline_en: Audit technical SEO issues to boost search rankings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage website SEO and need to fix technical issues

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会检查网站的技术 SEO 健康度，包括爬取、索引、Core Web Vitals、robots.txt、站点地图、规范标签、重定向和迁移。它会给出评分和修复优先级列表。
howto.when: 当你要求“检查技术 SEO”或提到网站速度、核心网页指标、索引问题、Google 找不到页面等关键词时触发。

say.text: 检查 example.com 的技术 SEO。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整的技术 SEO 审计。

say.text: 检查 example.com 的 Core Web Vitals。
say.note: Claude 只评估网站速度指标。

say.text: 审计从旧域名到新域名的迁移。
say.note: Claude 会执行预迁移审计。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude audits technical SEO health: crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, and migrations. It produces a scored diagnosis and prioritized fix roadmap.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "check technical SEO" or mention site speed, Core Web Vitals, indexing issues, or Google not finding pages.

say_en.note: Claude runs a full technical audit.

say_en.text: Check Core Web Vitals for example.com.
Audit migration from old.com to new.com.
